Reviews

What schools say, in their own words

Nothing on this page is written by us, and nothing on it can be. A review can only be written from inside the software, by the owner or principal of a school that has been using it for three weeks and has issued twenty real receipts.

How this is kept honest, in four rules. One review per school, enforced by the database and not by a form. It publishes itself a day after it is written, so there is no approval queue for inconvenient reviews to sit in. We can only take one down for something like spam or naming a child, never for being critical, and every removal is recorded with its reason and its rating in our own audit log. And the average below counts every published review, with the full spread of ratings printed beside it, so a curated average would be obvious from the shape of it.

No reviews yet

A school can only write one after using this for three weeks and issuing twenty real receipts, which is deliberate: it is what makes the reviews on this page worth reading. Nothing here is written by us, and there is nothing here yet.

Reviews we do not have

There are none from before a school had used the software properly, none from an account that never took a fee, and none written by us. There are also none bought from anywhere. If this page is short, it is short because we are new, and a short honest page is worth more to you than a long one you cannot check.

Google shows stars beside a business from its own Business Profile rather than from a company's own website, so if you want to see us rated somewhere we do not control, look us up there.
